variables.title: Variables
variables.code:
def dynamicVar = "Any type"
final String constant = "Fixed"
dynamicVar = 42
variables.notes: Use 'def' for dynamic typing. Static types are optional.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
int i = 1
BigDecimal bd = 1.0 // default decimal
boolean b = true
String s = "Double quotes with ${i}"
char c = 'Single'
data_types.notes: Groovy uses BigDecimal by default for floating point literals.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: '==' checks logical equality. Safe navigation operator '?.' avoids NPEs.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: Groovy's switch statement is extremely flexible, allowing ranges, types, and closures.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.code:
for (i in 1..5) { println i }

collection.each { item -> println item }
for_loop.notes: Closures like '.each' are idiomatic Groovy for iteration.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: The 'return' keyword is optional; the last evaluated expression is returned.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.code:
def list = [1, 2, 3] // ArrayList by default
def arr = [1, 2, 3] as int[]
list << 4 // append
arrays.notes: Square brackets create ArrayLists. Coerce to array using 'as'.

maps.title: Maps
maps.code:
def map = [name: "Groovy", age: 20]
map.newKey = "value"
println map['name']
maps.notes: Map literal syntax. Keys are strings by default unless wrapped in ().

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Exception types in catch blocks are optional.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Groovy provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Groovy supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Groovy provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Groovy converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Groovy represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Groovy formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Groovy branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Groovy defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Groovy iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Groovy organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Groovy stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Groovy groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Groovy tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Groovy organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
